subject: Request: Polaris Data pilot extension + combined credits & rate concession
messages:
From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@polarisdata.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: pilot extension + credits/top-up

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineers were impressed with the latency profile on our smaller batches. We're running into a scheduling delay on our internal security review that will push our evaluation window out by two—three weeks. Given that, could Redwood extend our pilot and provide a one-time credits top-up so we can complete a fuller test (longer sequence run, embedding re-indexing)?

Quick context: we hit an internal snag with data ingress that wasted about a week; we estimate we need ~25k additional token credits to complete the second wave of tests. Separately, Procurement asked if there's room for an introductory committed rate if we agree to a 12-month early-access pilot (we'd move to a paid plan after the pilot).

What I'd like to understand:
- One-time credits: ~25k token-equivalent top-up
- Pilot extension: +21 days
- Introductory committed discount (if we do 12-month commit) — procurement is asking for something meaningful to offset onboarding risk

Can you share what flexibility is available? We need a response by EOD Wednesday to keep internal momentum.

Thanks,
Ethan Ross
Head of ML Platform
Polaris Data

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@polarisdata.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension + credits/top-up

Ethan — appreciate the heads up and totally reasonable ask.

We can do a 21-day extension and a credits top-up; need to get exec approval for anything materially above our standard pilot allowance. My preliminary proposal:
- 21-day extension (no change in T&Cs)
- One-time credits top-up: $25,000 equivalent (approx 25k of your token estimate)
- Introductory committed discount: 20% off list for first 12 months if you sign an annual commitment at the end of the pilot

Two notes: discounts greater than 15% or credits above $20k require leadership sign-off. I have cc'd Lauren to escalate for approval this afternoon. If you can send the procurement contact and the expected commit date, I can include that in the ask.

Also attaching the usage spreadsheet you referenced (I filled in a rough cost projection).

- Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: polaris_usage_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 18:22:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Request: pilot extension + credits/top-up

FW: Jordan / quick summary and recommendation.

Polaris Data (mid-market analytics, likely ARR $600k-$900k over 3 years). They hit a deploy delay; asking for 21-day pilot extension, $25k one-time credits, and a 12-month introductory discount. Jordan is proposing 20% / $25k.

My read: high strategic fit (edge-case optimizer for our latency claims), good reference potential, strong chance to convert if we lock a 12-month commit. Recommend approving $25k credits + 18% discount (compromise) with the condition of: signed MPA within 30 days of pilot conclusion and auto-renew opt-out limited.

Estimated near-term impact:
- Revenue delta (first 12 months at 18%): ~$120k ARR net of discount
- Cost of concession (credits recognized against usage): ~$25k upfront
- Upside: reference and platform benchmarking across their engineering org

Requesting quick signoff from Marissa or Markus; need response to customer by Wednesday EOD.

Lauren Bishop
Sales Manager, Enterprise

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 08:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Request: pilot extension + credits/top-up

Thanks Lauren — quick questions before sign-off:
1) Can we tighten the MPA signature window to 21 days instead of 30? I want momentum preserved but less open-ended exposure.
2) If we agree to $25k credits + 18% discount, can we require a minimum monthly consumption floor after conversion (to protect revenue)?

If both answers are yes, I'm inclined to approve. Markus — can you confirm P&L impact and whether finance needs any additional clauses (prepaid vs. usage credit recognition)?

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Request: pilot extension + credits/top-up

Marissa / team — finance ops here. Quick answers:
1) 21-day MPA signature window: acceptable. We'll add an auto-expiry clause if not signed (credits expire).
2) Minimum consumption floor: recommend a 25% of expected ARR monthly floor for the first 3 months post-conversion. If they fail to hit floor, credits are clawed back pro rata or converted to a prepay invoice.

P&L: Approving $25k in credits and 18% discount reduces near-term recognized revenue but is acceptable with a signed 12-month commit; modeled payback within 9 months based on expected usage. No additional finance clause required beyond the consumption floor and the signature window.

I approve contingent on the two conditions above and a docuSign routing that enforces the timeline.

-Markus
Head, Revenue Operations
Attachment: draft_mpa_redlines.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@polarisdata.com>, Polaris Data Procurement <procurement@polarisdata.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: Polaris pilot extension + credits & intro discount (terms)

Ethan — good news. Leadership has approved a one-time credits top-up and an introductory committed discount subject to the conditions below. Please find the agreed terms: 

- Pilot extension: +21 days (effective immediately)
- One-time credits: $25,000 (applied to pilot usage)
- Introductory committed discount: 18% off list for first 12 months upon execution of the MPA
- Conditions: MPA must be signed within 21 days of pilot end; minimum monthly consumption floor equal to 25% of the projected monthly ARR for the first 3 months after conversion; credits expire if the MPA is not signed within the signature window

I've attached the redlined MPA and included a DocuSign routing for signature. If this looks good on your side, please confirm procurement contact and preferred signer and we'll send the DocuSign today.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.redwood.ai/PLS-2027-019/secure (expires in 21 days)

Thanks all — Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachment: draft_mpa_redlines.pdf (pdf)
